newsitem.title: USA: Immunomedics LeukoScan 2nd use not yet ok.
newsitem.headline: Immunomedics LeukoScan 2nd use not yet ok.

text.p: Immunomedics Inc said Friday that its European filing for a second indicated use for LeukoScan, diagnosing acute, non-classic appendicitis, is not yet approvable, because of the need for certain clarifications by the company.
The application for this additional use was filed four months ago.

"Although there can be no assurance as to the ultimate outcome or its timing, we believe that we can resolve these issues," David Goldenberg, chairman and chief exeutive officer said in a press release.
Immunomedics aslo said it has hired its first sales representatives for Germany, Austria and Switzerland to sell LeukoScan, which is approved in the European Union for diagnosing osteomyelitis.
An application to seek approval for sale of LeukoScan in Switzerland is under preparation.
